INSTRUMENTS_ISSUERS: 16,311 mid/small-cap CIKs identified in FSDS (excluding top 500 by filing frequency); 16,215 joined to companyfacts.zip (99.4% join rate)
PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE: Filing date ('filed' field in companyfacts.json XBRL facts and FSDS sub.txt). Availability instant = the date a fact was filed with SEC, not the fiscal-period date or acceptance timestamp.
SURVIVORSHIP_STATE: PRESERVED. Delisted and inactive CIKs remain fully retrievable: FSDS retains submissions for all historical CIKs; companyfacts.zip includes completed filers. Spot-checked: SELECT MEDICAL CORP (CIK 1035688), AFFINIA GROUP INC. (CIK 1328654), VERSO QUINNESEC LLC (CIK 1395864) all present in FSDS sub.txt across their filing years.
DELISTED_INACTIVE_COVERAGE: 96 mid/small-cap CIKs in FSDS not yet in companyfacts.zip (~0.6% of mid/small-cap); likely represent very recent delistings or inactive filers. Estate must decide whether to exclude or mark inactive. FSDS itself is exhaustive for history.
MISSINGNESS: num.txt completely absent across all 68 FSDS quarters (2009q2-2026q1); all numeric XBRL facts sourced from companyfacts.zip only. companyfacts.zip covers 20,144 total CIKs; mid/small-cap join = 99.4%.
REVISION_BEHAVIOR: Latest-filed-as-of-decision-date (inherited from r58_pit_fundamental_panel_v1). For any decision date t, select the most recent fact with filed <= t. Restatement manifests as a newer filing date with revised values; both are retained in companyfacts; decision logic must filter to latest.
LICENSE_USAGE_CONSTRAINTS: SEC bulk data: public domain via SEC.gov EDGAR and data.sec.gov. No restrictions on internal research use.

certification_reason: FSDS + companyfacts structure is sound for PIT fundamentals with 99.4% mid/small-cap join rate and complete survivorship retention. Filing dates ('filed') are proper availability stamps. However, common-shares-outstanding field availability as history (not current scalar) was NOT confirmed within turn budget. Per estate decision rule, cannot assert PH04 (net share issuance) is unblocked without this confirmation, as current-scalar-as-history is documented as look-ahead contamination.
limitations_that_must_travel_with_it: Shares outstanding field (us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued or similar) must be confirmed as a time series (multiple filed dates per CIK) before PH04 net-share-issuance can be calculated. If only a current scalar exists, PH04 is look-ahead and must be rejected.
